REIN is an 8-hour staking game with two competing sides: Reflection and Injection. Every 8 hours, the majority wins.

💰 Reflection rewards winning stakers with $REIN. Reward rates significantly improve over time the longer your winning streak.

💰 Injection collects the 5% transaction fee into a growing pot. When Injection wins a round, that pot is distributed among Injection stakers. The longer the pot absorbs fees, the bigger the reward!

Time your entry accordingly, as stake weight is based on both size and time.

ModelMint V2, the Blind Press. Each launch strikes one token for one AI model, fixed 1,000,000,000 supply, straight onto a pons_v2 bonding curve on Robinhood Chain. Using the model pays a 20% markup, the markup lands as ETH in the token's vault, and a keeper buys the token and burns it. Every platform fee does the same for $MINT. V2 adds the blind path: no stored prompts, no identity handed to the model, nothing on chain linking a burn to a prompt. No staking, no emissions, no promised yield.

TALIS is an onchain structured markets protocol built for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain.

TALIS lets the same underlying asset serve two different market views. Holders can earn premium by giving up a defined portion of their future upside, while traders with stronger conviction can buy concentrated exposure to that upside.

Each market operates through defined periods with transparent pricing, strike levels and onchain settlement. Instead of relying on traditional perpetual leverage, funding rates or liquidation mechanics, upside positions are backed by the underlying assets locked within the protocol.

For holders, TALIS creates a way to generate income from assets they already own. For traders, it creates a way to isolate and trade the part of a market move they actually want.

One asset. Different outcomes.

100% of protocol revenue buys back $TALIS.

Built on Robinhood Chain.
